workflow_obligations.anchor: 1. Reproduce it yourself on the matching surface
workflow_obligations.outcome: Reproduce the reported failure on the installed Codex hook.
Eliminate competing causes until the failing mechanism remains.
Choose the workflow-state repair before changing the hook implementation.

workflow_obligations.anchor: 4. Verify on the same surface; the original repro now passes.
workflow_obligations.outcome: Run the original false-block and compact-continuity reproductions after the fix.

workflow_obligations.anchor: 5. Stage the commits so the failing repro lands before the fix
workflow_obligations.outcome: Keep failing-before and passing-after evidence in review order.
Run the playbook's final delivery step only when the user authorizes it.
workflow_obligations.skip_condition: The user did not request a commit or pull request.

workflow_obligations.outcome: Close every approved gate with current evidence before reporting completion.
Run the Akita shape audit and the conditional deep-module audit on changed interfaces.
Lint user-visible prose and memory notes before they leave the agent.
Give every agent-facing step a checkable completion criterion.
Use method, obligation, frame, receipt, and checkpoint consistently.
Keep fast red and green checks for every reported hook failure.
Reduce each false block and compact failure to its smallest deterministic fixture.
Rank and falsify competing causes for command blocks and compact drift.
Inspect installed hook state, receipts, and exact denial messages.
Land each fix with a regression at the public hook seam.
Remove temporary artifacts and rerun the original installed-hook failures.
Trace the current hook, lifecycle, and persisted-state behavior before choosing the replacement shape.
Compare structurally distinct enforcement designs and screen their interfaces for design faults.
Select the synthesized design without adding a human checkpoint that the user did not request.

workflow_obligations.anchor: ## Phase D: Implement against the sketch
workflow_obligations.outcome: Keep implementation aligned with the chosen method-policy and workflow-state split.

workflow_obligations.anchor: ## Phase E: Scrap when the architecture is wrong
workflow_obligations.outcome: Restart the design if repeated implementation friction disproves the chosen shape.
workflow_obligations.skip_condition: The final implementation shows no repeated architectural friction.

workflow_obligations.outcome: Keep obligation validation behind one small interface used by hook adapters.
Name the intended behavior, the faulty behavior, and the smallest observable reproduction.
Use the existing hook and lifecycle unittest seams instead of building a second test framework.
Add a focused regression before each corresponding production fix.
Record that each new regression fails for the reported mechanism before the fix.
Apply the smallest production change that makes the focused regression pass.
Record the same focused regression passing after the fix.
Run adjacent hook, memory, trust, and installed-lifecycle checks.
Keep red before green and test only through agreed public seams.

workflow_obligations.anchor: Run typechecking regularly, single test files regularly, and the full test suite once at the end.

Pin the repository diff used for the final review.

Report standards and specification findings as separate review axes.

principles.name: principle-boundary-discipline
principles.decision: Parse METHOD.json and FLOW.json at the hook boundary. Keep source selection and progress checks pure.

principles.name: principle-build-the-lever
principles.decision: Make the hook tests and lifecycle verifier reproduce every compact and readiness claim.

principles.name: principle-fix-root-causes
principles.decision: Fix numbered compact notes, SessionStart checkpoint inject, context limit 0, and remove shell read/write classification from method enforcement.

principles.name: principle-laziness-protocol
principles.decision: Extend append_checkpoint, session_start, and planning_paths. Delete shell classification from the enforcement path. No new plugin.

principles.name: principle-prove-it-works
principles.decision: Run the Codex PreToolUse, compact lifecycle, and exact packet checks through unittest and the installed hook.

principles.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
principles.decision: Failing tests first, then the fix, then install-check.

principles.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
principles.decision: Lock Bash bypass, full principle accounting, progress restore, and compact receipts into regressions.

principles.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
principles.decision: Compare a hard-coded phase machine, an eager source dump, and source pointers with an applicability ledger.

principles.name: principle-experience-first
principles.decision: Show a compact restore receipt that lets the user match SessionStart to the prior PreCompact record.

principles.name: principle-foundational-thinking
principles.decision: Separate immutable method policy, mutable workflow progress, and append-only memory before adding checks.

principles.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
principles.decision: Inject the principle index and active leaves. Record a reason for every inactive leaf.

principles.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
principles.decision: Make repeated PreCompact and compact SessionStart calls append receipts and converge on current source hashes.

principles.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
principles.decision: Use one progress stack with exact source anchors instead of copying each workflow into hook code.

principles.name: principle-model-the-domain
principles.decision: Model nested workflows as ordered source-anchor frames, not scattered phase booleans.

principles.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
principles.decision: Proceed with reversible hook changes and reserve blocking for explicit method violations and Stop evidence.

principles.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
principles.decision: Treat compact continuity as a first-class method requirement instead of adding another shell classifier.

principles.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
principles.decision: Bind progress and unlazy completion to one named session scope. Ignore unrelated scope directories.

principles.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
principles.decision: Remove Bash enforcement and cross-scope inference before adding progress validation.

principle_exclusions.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
principle_exclusions.reason: This repair changes lifecycle state and does not introduce a replacement internal API.

principle_exclusions.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
principle_exclusions.reason: This repair is a bug fix, not a planned rewrite or migration with temporary breakage.

principle_exclusions.name: principle-type-system-discipline
principle_exclusions.reason: The touched runtime is Python and has no static type checker in this repository.
